controller_note: Reflex with the visual encoder trained with throws up to 7 m, perception in the loop; wrist reflex keeps both palms up; simulated throws.

criteria.chest: box held in the chest region (paper's chest criterion, used for distance / payload / offset)
criteria.sustained: box held until the episode ends without dropping (used for box size)

default.why: paper reference distance 3.0-3.5 m: at 2.5 m the arm trigger fires before the box is released in most throws

selection_note: Each cell: n first throws (one per simulated env); stored replays = first 5 successes + first failure by env index. Rates are over all n.

stored.rule: first 5 CLEAN catches by env index (sustained hold, arms down until release, box on the forearms) + first failure
